title: Medial Femoral Condyle
note: Generated by tools/figures.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification and source fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. A figure the reviewer corrects or deletes is marked REMOVED rather than removed from this file.

figures.claim: Its articular surface is more curved than the lateral and narrower from side to side, and the cartilage over it is of the order of 2 to 3 mm thick.
The medial condyle carries the greater share of load through most of the range, conventionally taught as about 60 per cent in a normally aligned knee in stance.
